title: Text: DET David Chadd ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Can we meet up? Working on a story about how the █████████ trade went down. Just want to verify some details I've gathered.
I can meet up but those details will have to come from ██
Let me know when and where. Anything will help.
I'm on the phone in office! T██king to ██ is your best bet
I'm trying to fish him out, too. I'm just trying to write a good story, not going to be intrusive to trade secrets.
